rules.title: A section link lands below the sticky header, not under it

steps.heading: 1. Scroll to the top of the page
steps.text: Scroll to the top of the page. Click a navigation link that jumps to a section on the same page.

steps.heading: 2. Verify the heading of the section that was…
steps.text: Verify the heading of the section that was jumped to is fully visible and is not covered by the header.

sample.text: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)

rules.fix: Set scroll-padding-top on the html element and scroll-margin-top on each section to the header height plus a small gap. Give the header an opaque or blurred background so content never shows through it.
rules.statement: When a link jumps to a section, the section heading ends up fully visible below the sticky header. The header never covers it.

rules.title: Every page uses the same navigation and footer

steps.text: Open the home page. Store the navigation labels as 'home_nav'. Use the navigation to open two other pages of the site.
Verify on each of those pages that the navigation shows the same labels as the stored home_nav and that the page has the same footer as the home page.

failure.message: project/folder gate failed: error: profile "default" (prod) has no project/folder configured AND no TMS credentials were available to auto-configure one.

rules.fix: Render the navigation and footer from one shared component or template. Remove page-specific headers and old stylesheets.
rules.statement: All pages share one design system. The navigation labels and the footer on the home page appear unchanged on the other pages.

rules.title: Pages load and work without console errors or blocked resources

steps.heading: 1. Open the home page and scroll to the bottom
steps.text: Open the home page and scroll to the bottom. Verify the page finished loading with its main content visible.

steps.heading: 2. Open one more page from the navigation
steps.text: Open one more page from the navigation. Verify that page also finished loading with its main content visible.

failure.message: The browser console reported 2 problems while the rule ran.
failure.happened: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found) | Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
failure.suggestedFix: Fix each console error listed, then rerun. Add any missing file such as the favicon.

sample.text: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)

rules.fix: Open the browser console, fix each error, and add any missing file such as the favicon. Remove inline scripts or hash them in the Content Security Policy.
rules.statement: Browsing the main pages produces no console errors, no failed requests and no Content Security Policy violations.

rules.title: Text stays readable in both themes

steps.heading: 1. Look at the page in its current theme
steps.text: Look at the page in its current theme. Verify the body text and the smaller muted text are clearly legible against their backgrounds.

steps.heading: 2. Switch to the other theme with the theme control
steps.text: Switch to the other theme with the theme control. Verify the body text and the smaller muted text are still clearly legible.

failure.stepText: Switch to the other theme with the theme control. Verify the body text and the smaller muted text are still clearly legible.
failure.message: AP determined agent is stuck — no viable actions remain
failure.happened: The theme control accepts activation but does not visibly switch the page to the other theme.
failure.suggestedFix: Check the theme-control click and keyboard handlers and the code that applies the selected theme to the page. Retest both themes and confirm normal and muted text remain readable after the page actually changes theme.

sample.text: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)

rules.fix: Define text and background as paired tokens per theme and keep contrast at AA or better. Tune muted text separately for each theme.
rules.statement: Body text and muted text are comfortably legible against their background in the light theme and in the dark theme.

rules.title: Headings and labels describe a product, not a finding

steps.heading: 1. Read the main heading, every section heading…
steps.text: Read the main heading, every section heading and every badge or chip on the page. Verify none of them reads like an audit finding, a test report, an incident or a postmortem, and none uses capitalised alarm wording such as "DANGER", "BROKEN" or "CHEATS ON PURPOSE", unless the product itself is a security tool.

sample.text: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)

rules.fix: Rewrite each heading as what the visitor gets, for example "Buy some credits" instead of "3 sellers flagged". Move failures and checks into a later section or a collapsed group. Label demo data neutrally in a muted style, for example "demo seller".
rules.statement: Headings, section titles and status chips describe what the product gives the visitor. None of them reads like a security audit, a test report or a postmortem, and alarm labels are not used for demo or failed items.

rules.title: Keyboard focus is visible and reaches the main actions

steps.heading: 1. Press the Tab key four times
steps.text: Press the Tab key four times. Verify a visible focus ring or outline marks the element that has focus after each press.

sample.text: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)

rules.fix: Do not remove outlines. Add a focus-visible style with a two pixel ring in the accent colour to links, buttons and form fields.
rules.statement: Pressing Tab moves a clearly visible focus ring through the links and buttons in a sensible order, and reaches the primary action.

rules.title: The hero says what the visitor can do and offers the action

steps.heading: 1. Look at the top of the page without scrolling
steps.text: Look at the top of the page without scrolling. Store the main heading text as 'hero'. Verify the stored hero text tells a visitor what they can do or get with the product, in everyday words, and does not describe a test, audit, report or incident.

steps.heading: 2. Verify a primary call-to-action button or link…
steps.text: Verify a primary call-to-action button or link is visible without scrolling and its label names an action, such as "Start", "Try", "Get", "Install", "Borrow" or "Browse".

sample.text: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)

rules.fix: Rewrite the main heading as the job, for example "Borrow a tool. Lend one." instead of "Tool lending platform". Put one primary button directly under it with a verb label. Move proof, verification and security wording to a supporting section further down.
rules.statement: The first screen leads with the visitor's job. One heading says what the product does for them in plain words, and one primary button or link starts that job. The heading never describes a test, an audit or an incident.

rules.title: The top menu groups pages into categories with submenus

steps.heading: 1. Look at the main navigation bar
steps.text: Look at the main navigation bar. Verify it shows between 3 and 6 top-level items.

steps.heading: 2. Hover over a top-level item that groups several…
steps.text: Hover over a top-level item that groups several pages. Verify a submenu opens and lists that item's pages or sections.
Press the Escape key. Verify the submenu closes.

failure.stepText: Hover over a top-level item that groups several pages. Verify a submenu opens and lists that item's pages or sections.
failure.message: Final verification failed: "A submenu opens and lists that item's pages or sections."
failure.happened: The run did not successfully hover and preserve the expanded navigation menu before checking it. It then incorrectly concluded that a submenu had opened.
failure.suggestedFix: Repeat the run by moving the pointer onto “Browse tools,” wait until its menu is visibly shown, and verify the visible menu items before making the final check.

sample.text: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)

rules.fix: Group links into three to six categories. Give a category with children a button with aria-haspopup and aria-expanded. Open its menu on hover, on focus and on tap. Close it on Escape and on outside click. Do not trap focus.
rules.statement: The top navigation shows three to six category items. A category that holds several pages opens a submenu on hover and on keyboard focus, and Escape closes it.

rules.title: A missing page shows a designed not-found page with a way home

steps.heading: 1. Open the site's address followed by the path…
steps.text: Open the site's address followed by the path /plumb-missing-page-404. Verify a page in the site's own design appears with a heading that says the page was not found and a link back to the home page.

failure.stepText: Open the site's address followed by the path /plumb-missing-page-404. Verify a page in the site's own design appears with a heading that says the page was not found and a link back to the home page.
failure.message: The requested URL renders only a bare Not Found response, with no site-design heading or home link.
failure.happened: The site does not serve its branded missing-page screen for this address. It returns a plain 404 response, so visitors cannot see the expected message or use a link back home.
failure.suggestedFix: Configure this missing address to render the site's page-not-found design, including a clear not-found heading and a link to the home page.

sample.text: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)

rules.fix: Add a 404 page that reuses the shared header and footer, says plainly that the page was not found, and links home. Configure the host to serve it for unknown paths.
rules.statement: Opening an address that does not exist shows a page in the site's own design, with the navigation and a link back home, not a blank screen or a raw server error.

rules.title: Both sides of a two-sided product get a path and a section

steps.heading: 1. Scroll through the page
steps.text: Scroll through the page. Verify the page either gives each kind of user, for example buyers and sellers, its own labelled card or section, or states plainly in one sentence who the product is for.

sample.text: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)

rules.fix: Add a second path card for the missing side with its own action button. Add a short "how it works in three steps" strip for each side. Show both sides' commands if the product has a CLI.
rules.statement: If the product serves two kinds of people, such as buyers and sellers or borrowers and lenders, each side has its own path card and its own short section. A one-sided product says plainly who it is for.

rules.title: Status shows what the visitor cares about, not internals

steps.heading: 1. Find the status text, badge or banner near the…
steps.text: Find the status text, badge or banner near the top of the page. Verify it states something a visitor cares about and shows no internal identifier, account id, job id or contract plumbing.

sample.text: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)

rules.fix: Replace internal wording with a plain statement of state. Move identifiers to a details row, the docs or the footer.
rules.statement: Status text and chips say things a visitor cares about, such as "Market open" or "3 listings for sale". Internal accounts, grader names, challenge windows and contract plumbing are kept to docs or the footer.

rules.title: Light and dark themes both work and the choice sticks

steps.heading: 1. Look for a control that switches the page…
steps.text: Look for a control that switches the page between a light and a dark theme. Verify such a control is visible.

steps.heading: 2. Click the theme control
steps.text: Click the theme control. Verify the page background colour changed.
Reload the page. Verify the page still shows the theme that was chosen before the reload.

failure.stepText: Click the theme control. Verify the page background colour changed.
failure.message: Final verification failed: "the page background colour changed."
failure.happened: The theme control accepted the click but did not apply the expected dark background to the page.
failure.suggestedFix: Check the theme control’s click handler and the dark-theme styles. Ensure the chosen theme is applied to the page background after the control is selected.

sample.text: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)

rules.fix: Add a toggle button in the header with an accessible label such as "Switch between light and dark theme". Define colours as tokens swapped by a data-theme attribute on the root element. Save the choice in localStorage and read it in a small inline script in the head, before any stylesheet, so there is no flash of the wrong theme.
rules.statement: Every page offers a visible theme switch. Switching changes the page colours, and the choice survives a reload.
